<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Livewire\Component;
use App\Models\Url;

class UrlComponent extends Component
{
    public function store($link)
    {
        $this->validate([
            'link' => 'required|url',
        ]);

        Url::create([
            'original' => $link,
            'shortened' => $this->generateShortenedUrl(),
        ]);

        $this->emit('urlSaved');
    }

    public function delete($urlId)
    {
        Url::destroy($urlId);

        $this->emit('urlDeleted');
    }

    private function generateShortenedUrl()
    {
        // Implement a logic to generate a short URL
        return uniqid();
    }
}
```
